demos.name: No tool, no promise
demos.description: A support agent can only commit the company through a tool. Same scripted agent, two tool sets, and a commitment ledger that only tools can write. Mock only: no tenant, no LLM.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 5350; npm run doctor checks it). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:5350 only; HOST_PORT changes it, and the shelf's Start button does not set HOST_PORT). Edit composeFile to this checkout's absolute path.
